name: Echo CS-620P
blurb: A 59.8 cc professional saw: 16″, 18″, 20″, 24″ and 27″ bars on 3/8″ chain, .050″ gauge, 60–93 drive links per Echo's own chart.
intro: The Echo CS-620P is a 59.8 cc professional saw. Echo lists 16″ (accessory) through 27″ bars for the CS-620P on 3/8″ .050″ chain; the chart groups the CS-620P, CS-620PW and CS-680 on the same bar-and-chain rows. Note the 24″ bar takes 81 links here, while the CS-590's 24″ bar can take 84. Every row below is restated from the bars-and-chains chart in Echo's chainsaw catalog, which gives the bar part number, chain part number, drive-link count, gauge, pitch and file size for each saw. Echo's catalog is written for dealers selling Echo loops, so the chain numbers are Echo part numbers; the pitch, gauge and drive-link count are what carry over to any other brand's chain. If your saw has had a replacement bar, check the stamp.

bars.note: Echo bar 16D0PS3860C; chain 72LPX60CQ. Echo’s specification table marks 16″ as an accessory-only bar length.
